title: Google Earth map of Montana 1975 sighting locations near Malmstrom AFB
description: Attachment 2 (page 38): a Google Earth satellite map of central Montana with placemarks labeled with locations and dates such as Fairfield, Vaughn, Great Falls IAP, Highwood Mountains and Bowmans Corner, mostly dated 10/75 through 12/75. Highway markers including US-287 and yellow road overlays are visible, consistent with the 1975 Malmstrom AFB sighting wave.
